annotations.text:
Two tweaks sit above each artboard.

State: First run shows the blurb, templates and footer. Returning shows the project shelf instead — that switch is veteran = signed in, or 2+ projects.

Dark flips the whole palette to the app's real dark tokens.

The isometric build plate only appears on desktop: the backdrop measures the space beside the text column and sits out below 420px of it, which every width under ~1120 is. Here it is a still — in the app a nozzle prints the first layer.
